title: Greenoaks leads SSI's $2B round, reportedly with $500M

sources.quote: Greenoaks led the latest round, committing $500 million, according to sources who spoke to the Financial Times.

explain: Greenoaks led a $2 billion round that valued Safe Superintelligence at $32 billion, reportedly putting in $500 million itself. Figures come from press reports, not the companies.
